description: This file defines the ADODB2_mssql class, which extends the ADODB_DataDict class to implement database schema management and manipulation specifically for Microsoft SQL Server within the ADOdb PHP library. It includes methods for handling data types, generating SQL commands for altering tables and columns, creating indexes, and managing SQL Server-specific syntax and features.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssql
classes.description: A PHP class extending ADODB_DataDict for managing Microsoft SQL Server schema operations within the ADOdb library.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Determines the internal type code for a given database field type, considering custom type mappings.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts a meta type code into the actual SQL Server data type string.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add columns to an existing table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Builds the suffix portion of the SQL column creation statement based on attributes like default value, auto-increment, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or dropping indexes, with support for options like UNIQUE and CLUSTERED.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the size or type string for a given field type and attributes, adapted for SQL Server specifics.
